definition: AI is the ability of computers to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes learning, reasoning, problem-solving, understanding language, and recognizing patterns.

examples.content: Like a village elder who has seen many things — the more they see, the better their guesses become.
Like a student learning to cook — at first they follow recipes exactly, after making many dishes they learn what tastes good together.
Email spam filters that learn what you mark as spam or not spam.
Voice assistants like Google Assistant that convert speech to text and find answers.
Weather prediction for farmers in Himachal Pradesh — predicting when rain will come, best planting times, frost warnings.

misconceptions: AI is not magic — it's mathematics, statistics, and clever programming
AI doesn't think like humans — it finds patterns in data
AI is not new — it's been around since the 1950s
AI won't replace all jobs — it changes what jobs require

metadata.author: Bhavya AI Lab
metadata.localRelevance: High — applicable to farming, weather prediction, plant disease detection
